title: Oplan Kaluluwa 2026: BFP inspects Cebu City cemeteries

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — In preparation for the expected influx of visitors in cemeteries on All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, the Bureau of Fire Protection in Central Visayas (BFP-7) has launched an intensified fire safety inspection and awareness campaign across public cemeteries in Cebu City. Led by BFP-7 Regional Director Rodolfo P. Denaga and Cebu City Fire Marshal Tito P. Purgatorio, the initiative brought together Cebu City fire station commanders and fire safety inspectors to conduct thorough site assessments and distribute fire safety leaflets under Oplan Kaluluwa 2026.
